title: Abscisic acid for acute respiratory distress syndrome therapy by suppressing alveolar macrophage pyroptosis via upregulating acyloxyacyl hydrolase expression.
authors: Wang, Lixia; Shen, Jian; Liu, Weiju; Li, Wei; Tang, Weijie; Zha, Binshan; Wu, Huimei; Liu, Xuesheng; Shen, Qiying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脱落酸通过上调AOAH抑制肺泡巨噬细胞焦亡治疗ARDS，仅涉及转录因子PPARγ的间接调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Abscisic acid (ABA) is a phytohormone that inhibits airway inflammation in acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) mouse models. However, the molecular mechanism underlying this phenomenon remains unclear. METHODS: Serum ABA level in patients and mice was measured via liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). In-depth molecular mechanism was investigated through transmission electron microscopy, RNA-sequencing, and molecular docking in ARDS mice and cultured primary alveolar macrophages (AMs). RESULTS: We found that the serum ABA level was remarkably decreased in ARDS mice and patients. ABA inhibited lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced airway in fl ammation in mice; moreover, it downregulated genes associated with pyroptosis, as shown by RNA-sequencing and lung protein immunoblots. ABA inhibited the formation of membrane pores in AMs and suppressed the cleavage of gasdermin D (GSDMD) and the activation of caspase-11 and caspase-1 in vivo and in vitro; however, the overexpression of caspase-11 reversed the protective effect of ABA on LPS-induced pyroptosis of primary AMs. ABA inhibited intra-AM LPS accumulation while increasing the level of acyloxyacyl hydrolase (AOAH) in AMs, whereas AOAH de fi ciency abrogated the suppressive action of ABA on inflammation, pyroptosis, and intra-AM LPS accumulation in vivo and in vitro. Importantly, ABA promoted its intracellular receptor lanthionine C-like receptor 2 interacting with transcription factor peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma, which ultimately leading to increase AOAH expression to inactivate LPS and inhibit pyroptosis in AMs. CONCLUSIONS: ABA protected against LPS-induced lung injury by inhibiting pyroptosis in AMs via proliferator-activated receptor gamma-mediated AOAH expression.
abstract_zh: 目的：脱落酸（ABA）是一种植物激素，在急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）小鼠模型中抑制气道炎症。然而，其背后的分子机制尚不清楚。方法：通过液相色谱-串联质谱法（LC-MS/MS）测量患者和小鼠血清中ABA水平。在ARDS小鼠和培养的原代肺泡巨噬细胞（AMs）中，通过透射电子显微镜、RNA测序和分子对接深入研究分子机制。结果：我们发现，ARDS小鼠和患者血清中ABA水平显著降低。ABA抑制了脂多糖（LPS）诱导的小鼠气道炎症；此外，RNA测序和肺蛋白免疫印迹显示，ABA下调了与焦亡相关的基因。ABA在体内和体外抑制了AMs中膜孔的形成，并抑制了gasdermin D（GSDMD）的裂解以及caspase-11和caspase-1的激活；然而，caspase-11的过表达逆转了ABA对LPS诱导的原代AMs焦亡的保护作用。ABA抑制了AMs内LPS的积累，同时增加了AMs中酰氧基酰基水解酶（AOAH）的水平，而AOAH缺乏在体内和体外均消除了ABA对炎症、焦亡和AMs内LPS积累的抑制作用。重要的是，ABA促进了其胞内受体羊毛硫氨酸C样受体2与转录因子过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ的相互作用，最终导致AOAH表达增加，从而灭活LPS并抑制AMs中的焦亡。结论：ABA通过过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ介导的AOAH表达抑制AMs中的焦亡，从而保护免受LPS诱导的肺损伤。
